english.title: Retailer supply relevant product via cross border distance sale to member State in which such sales were prohibited
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a retailer, supplied a relevant product, namely **(..SPECIFY PRODUCT..), via a cross-border distance sale to a consumer located in a member State, namely **(..SPECIFY MEMBER STATE..), in which cross border distances sales were prohibited in accordance with Article 18(1) of the Tobacco Products Directive
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 47(7), 48(f) and 51 of the Tobacco and Related Products Regulations 2016 and section 2(2) of the European Communities Act 1972.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) In any proceedings for an offence under these Regulations brought against a person who supplies any tobacco product or related product in breach of these Regulations, it is a defence that the supplier exercised all due diligence to avoid committing the offence.
